prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Secure Your Pet Cloud Backup", "Sign in now to save your pet companion and enable seamless syncing across devices."]
1: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Verify your companion's details and seal your adoption record.", "Pet Name"]
2: ["Verifying Desktop Workspace", "Checking screen resolution and overlay compatibility for your desktop pet.", "Screen compatibility check in progress..."]
3: ["Discover Your Companion Path", "Select standard adoption for instant pairing or custom creation for a unique companion.", "Instant Pet Pair vs Custom Creation"]
4: ["Signing in connects your companion to secure cloud storage so your pet progress is never lost.", "Cloud Pet Preservation Active"]
5: ["Companion Creation Photo Upload", "Ensure your image is well-lit and front-facing for best custom pet generation.", "Select Companion Photo"]
6: ["Your desktop pet is actively preparing in the background. You can minimize this window anytime."]
7: ["Look for the pet icon in your system tray to adjust visibility or bring your pet to the front.", "System Tray Controls"]
8: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Companion Journey", "Bring an intelligent, interactive companion directly to your desktop workspace in just a few steps."]
9: ["Your Desktop Companion is Ready!", "Your pet is now active on your desktop. Click and drag or use the system tray to manage controls."]

verdicts.problem: Asks for personal information (photo of the user)
